userRequest: Choose an authorization system for nested teams, shared projects, and inherited document access.
successConditions: A user can inherit document access through team and project relationships.
Authorization decisions remain consistent across four application replicas.

identityFacts: The verified access token supplies actor and organization identifiers.
dataFacts: Projects can be shared with teams, teams can be nested, and documents belong to projects.
operationalFacts: The platform team can operate one additional self-hosted service backed by PostgreSQL.

hardConstraints.statement: The solution must represent nested team and shared-resource relationships without copying all inherited permissions into application rows.
The integration path must support Node.js 24.

preferences.statement: Prefer one consistent relationship model across all replicas.

reasonCodes.description: The candidate can express decisions inside application code or an embedded model.
The candidate adds a separately operated policy service.
The candidate directly models resource relationships and inheritance.
The candidate supports the repository runtime.

unknowns.description: The effort to migrate existing membership rows into a relationship model is not measured.
